summary: SM1 is the first of up to four connected 300 mm fabs on Texas Instruments' Sherman, Texas site, built for analog and embedded processing chips. TI chose Sherman in November 2021, broke ground in May 2022 and said in December 2025 that SM1 was in production, starting with analog power products and ramping with customer demand. Federal CHIPS funding was finalized for SM1 and the second Sherman fab in December 2024.

Preliminary CHIPS terms for three TI fabs: two in Sherman, Texas and one in Lehi, Utah. The first Sherman fab's share was to fund its cleanroom and pilot line.

TI announced on 17 December 2025 that SM1 was in production and shipping to customers.
